subject: Christian Watson
headline: Christian Watson Left in an Ambulance, Then Came Back to Help Beat Carolina
title: Christian Watson Returns to Lift Packers Past the Panthers
subheadline: Green Bay's receiver went to the hospital for tests, returned in the third quarter and finished with 113 yards in a 27-19 Thursday night win.
author: Top Selling Jerseys
description: Christian Watson left for hospital tests, came back and posted 113 yards as Jordan Love threw three touchdowns in the Packers' 27-19 win over Carolina.
searchIntent: Fans who saw or heard about Watson's scare on Thursday night want the full story of his return and the Packers' win, with a path to his jersey.
body: Few players get taken from a stadium by ambulance and still lead their team in receiving that same night. Christian Watson did exactly that on Thursday.

The [Green Bay Packers wide receiver](/players/christian-watson/) caught eight of his 10 targets for 113 yards as Green Bay beat the Carolina Panthers 27-19 at Lambeau Field on Oct. 29. His biggest gain was a 53-yard catch in the first half. After that play he was sent to a local hospital for precautionary tests on his chest. The tests came back clear, and he was back on the field in the third quarter.
## Watson's second-half return

Watson made a couple of important catches after his return, including one that helped Green Bay close out the game. The night was not spotless for him, since he also lost a fumble, but no Packer finished with more receiving yards.
## Jordan Love and the pass rush

[Jordan Love](/players/jordan-love/) completed 30 of 41 passes for 288 yards and three touchdowns, with one interception and a 106.6 passer rating. That kept the offense moving even though the Packers turned the ball over three times, starting with a fumble on the opening kickoff.
The defense made sure those mistakes did not cost the game. Green Bay sacked Bryce Young six times. Young finished 23 of 41 for 209 yards, with one touchdown and one interception.
The win lifted the Packers to 5-3 and dropped Carolina to 3-4.
## What it means going forward

Watson's speed is what makes Green Bay's passing game hard to defend, and this game showed how much the offense leans on him for big plays. A clean bill of health after a scary moment is the best news the Packers could have gotten.

After a Thursday game, the Packers now get a few extra days before their next kickoff, and all eyes will be on Watson's status when practice resumes.

subject: Stephen Curry
headline: Stephen Curry Hits 44 in Minnesota and Adds Another Record to His Name
title: Stephen Curry Scores 44 as Warriors Win Again in Minnesota
subheadline: A perfect night at the line and a 23-point first half carried Golden State to a second straight win after an 0-3 start.
author: Top Selling Jerseys
description: Stephen Curry scored 44 points and made all 16 free throws in a 119-114 win at Minnesota, his NBA-record 46th 40-point game since turning 30.
searchIntent: Fans looking for the details of Curry's 44-point game and the record attached to it, with a link to his jersey.
body: Golden State opened the season 0-3. Two games later, Stephen Curry has the Warriors back within a game of .500, and on Wednesday he did it with one of the best scoring nights of his career's second act.

The [Warriors guard](/players/stephen-curry/) scored 44 points in a 119-114 win over the Minnesota Timberwolves in Minneapolis on Oct. 28. He made all 16 of his free throws. It was his 46th game of 40 or more points since his 30th birthday, the most by any player in NBA history, according to ESPN.
## A fast start and a steady finish
Curry came out hunting shots. He had 23 points by halftime on 8-of-16 shooting, with five 3-pointers, and Golden State built a lead that grew to 24.

Minnesota fought back in the fourth quarter and made the Warriors work for it. Curry closed the door from the line, making all seven of his free throws in the final eight minutes. He also played more than 30 minutes for the first time this season.
Yaxel Lendeborg gave him plenty of help, scoring 26 points on 11-of-20 shooting with nine rebounds.
## Why this one matters

The win was Golden State's second in a row, following a victory at Denver, and it moved the Warriors to 2-3. More than the record, it showed Curry can still carry an offense for a full game when the team needs a lift.
His jersey has long been one of the most familiar in the sport. Fans can see how he compares with the rest of the league on our [top selling NBA jerseys](/top-selling-nba-jerseys/) page.
## Up next: Lakers at Chase Center

The Warriors host the Los Angeles Lakers on Friday, Oct. 30. That means a matchup with Luka Dončić, who opened his own season with a [52-point game in Utah](/news/luka-doncic-52-points-lakers-start/). Two of the league's best scorers on the same floor is a strong way for Golden State to try to make it three straight.

subject: Allisha Gray
headline: The Dream Stay Alive and Send the WNBA Finals to Its First Game 7
title: Allisha Gray Leads Dream to the First Game 7 in WNBA Finals
subheadline: Atlanta blitzed Golden State early in Game 6, won 80-69 and set up a winner-take-all finale on Saturday night.
author: Top Selling Jerseys
description: Allisha Gray scored 23 as the Atlanta Dream beat Golden State 80-69 in Game 6, forcing the first Game 7 in WNBA Finals history on Saturday, Oct. 31.
searchIntent: Fans who want to know how Atlanta forced Game 7 and when the deciding game is, with a path to Dream jerseys.
body: One loss from elimination, Allisha Gray and the Atlanta Dream played their best quarter of the series. By the end of it, Game 6 of the WNBA Finals was all but decided.

Atlanta beat the Golden State Valkyries 80-69 on Oct. 29 in front of a sellout home crowd, despite a 12:30 p.m. ET start. The series is tied 3-3, and Saturday's Game 7 will be the first in WNBA Finals history.
## A first quarter that changed the series
Atlanta led only 6-5 before running off 13 straight points. The Dream made 11 of their 15 shots in the opening period, including six of eight from 3-point range, and led 32-15 after one.
Golden State never found a rhythm. The Valkyries made 9 of 34 shots in the first half and trailed 46-26 at the break. Atlanta's lead reached 25 points.

[Allisha Gray](/players/allisha-gray/) led the way with 23 points and made five of her seven 3-point attempts, including a late one that sealed it. [Rhyne Howard](/players/rhyne-howard/) added 21 points. [Angel Reese](/players/angel-reese/) posted a double-double with 15 points and 13 rebounds.
Gabby Williams scored 26 points for Golden State, and Tiffany Hayes added 15. The Valkyries trimmed the gap to 11 in the final two minutes, but that was as close as they got.
## History either way
Game 7 tips off at 8 p.m. ET on Saturday, Oct. 31, on Golden State's home floor. The winner becomes a first-time WNBA champion, so the league is guaranteed a new name on the trophy.

For Atlanta, it is a chance to finish a comeback after dropping Games 4 and 5. For the Valkyries, still early in their franchise history, it is a shot at a title on home court. Fans following both rosters can see where each team's stars stand on our [top selling WNBA jerseys](/top-selling-wnba-jerseys/) list. Whatever happens, the season ends with a game nobody has seen in the WNBA before.

subject: Milwaukee Brewers
headline: Milwaukee Throws Its First World Series Parade for the Brewers
title: Brewers World Series Parade: Route, Rally and How to Watch
subheadline: Two days after clinching the first title in franchise history, the Brewers celebrate with a downtown parade and a rally at the Summerfest grounds.
author: Top Selling Jerseys
description: The Brewers celebrate their first World Series title with a parade through downtown Milwaukee on Oct. 30. Here is the route, the rally and how to watch.
searchIntent: Fans planning to attend or watch the Brewers' championship parade want the route, times and viewing options, plus championship jersey options.
body: For the first time, the city gets to throw a World Series parade for the Milwaukee Brewers. The city celebrates on Friday, Oct. 30, two days after the team finished off the Tampa Bay Rays.

Milwaukee won Game 5 by a score of 4-1 on Oct. 28 to take the series four games to one. Catcher [William Contreras](/players/william-contreras/) was named World Series MVP. We covered the clincher in our story on the [Brewers' first championship](/news/brewers-world-series-champions/).
## Parade route and timing

The Parade of Champions starts at 10 a.m. Central at North Vel R. Phillips Avenue and West Wisconsin Avenue downtown. It ends at Henry Maier Festival Park, better known as the Summerfest grounds, where the championship rally takes place.

Gates at the festival grounds open at 8 a.m., and the festivities are scheduled to run until 3 p.m. Admission is free. The first 50,000 fans at the rally receive a limited-edition championship towel. Big screens will show the parade live, and the rally will include music, food and Brewers alumni.
Milwaukee Public Schools closed for the day so students and staff can take part.
## How to watch from home
MLB Network, MLB.tv, Brewers.tv and Brewers.com are carrying the celebration. In Milwaukee, CBS 58 begins coverage at 9 a.m. Central.
## Why the day matters

Milwaukee last celebrated an MLB title in 1957, when the city was home to the Braves. The Brewers had been to one World Series before this year, in 1982, and lost it. This parade closes a long wait for a fan base that packed watch parties across the area during the series.

Fans looking to mark the moment can start with the jerseys of the team's October stars, including Contreras and Game 5 starter [Jacob Misiorowski](/players/jacob-misiorowski/). Fans can also see how Brewers players compare on our [top selling MLB jerseys](/top-selling-mlb-jerseys/) page. Once the confetti settles, attention shifts to the offseason and to whether this core can make a run at a second straight title in 2027.

subject: Logan Cooley
headline: Logan Cooley Ties It With One Second Left, and Utah Wins in Overtime
title: Logan Cooley Hat Trick With One Second Left Stuns Pittsburgh
subheadline: The Mammoth center completed a hat trick at the final horn of regulation, and Mikhail Sergachev won it in overtime in Pittsburgh.
author: Top Selling Jerseys
description: Logan Cooley completed a hat trick with one second left in regulation, and Mikhail Sergachev won it in overtime as Utah beat Pittsburgh 4-3 on Oct. 29.
searchIntent: Fans who saw the last-second goal want the full sequence and context for Cooley's night, with a path to Mammoth jerseys.
body: Logan Cooley scored the first two goals of the night in Pittsburgh. His third, with one second left in regulation, is the one people will remember.

The [Utah Mammoth center](/players/logan-cooley/) completed a hat trick at the end of the third period to tie the Penguins 3-3 on Oct. 29. Defenseman [Mikhail Sergachev](/players/mikhail-sergachev/) then won it 4-3 at 3:27 of overtime, scoring from the slot off a rebound of a Barrett Hayton shot.
## How the night unfolded
Cooley struck twice in the first period. He picked off an Erik Karlsson pass and scored at 4:40, then added another at 14:11 for a 2-0 lead.
Pittsburgh came all the way back. Karlsson scored in the second period, Rickard Rakell tied it short-handed midway through the third, and Ben Kindel put the Penguins ahead with 25 seconds left.

Utah answered almost immediately. With the clock nearly gone, Cooley swatted a puck out of the air and tucked a backhand past Arturs Silovs. According to NHL.com, it was just the 10th game in league history, regular season or playoffs, with both a go-ahead goal and a tying goal in the final 30 seconds of regulation, and the first since April 7, 2015.
Sebastian Cossa made 31 saves for Utah.
## A breakout season taking shape
The hat trick was the fourth of Cooley's NHL career and his first since a four-goal game on Nov. 24, 2025. It gave him seven goals this season. Utah improved to 9-5-0.

Cooley has become one of the main reasons to watch the Mammoth, and this was his signature moment of the season so far. Fans can see how Utah's players compare with the league's biggest names on our [top selling NHL jerseys](/top-selling-nhl-jerseys/) page.
## What to watch next
Utah is off to a winning start, and Cooley is leading the charge up front. Nights like this one, decided in the final second, are how a young scorer turns into a household name across the league.

subject: Philadelphia Union
headline: From Last Place to the Playoffs: The Union Complete a Remarkable Turnaround
title: Philadelphia Union Clinch MLS Playoffs After a 1-10-4 Start
subheadline: A scoreless draw at Supporters' Shield winner Nashville sealed a postseason spot for a team that sat last in the league at the World Cup break.
author: Top Selling Jerseys
description: The Philadelphia Union clinched an MLS Cup Playoffs spot with a 0-0 draw at Nashville, capping a 12-1-4 run after a 1-10-4 start to the 2026 season.
searchIntent: Fans who want to know how the Union went from last place to a playoff spot and what comes next, with a path to Union jerseys.
body: In early summer, the Philadelphia Union were the worst team in MLS. On Wednesday night they booked a place in the playoffs.

Philadelphia clinched a spot in the MLS Cup Playoffs on Oct. 28 while playing Nashville SC to a 0-0 draw at Geodis Park. The berth became official when the New England Revolution beat Red Bull New York, with former Union midfielder Dániel Gazdag scoring the late winner.
## How the turnaround happened

The Union lost their first six matches of the season. By the World Cup break they were 1-10-4 and last in the table. Ryan Richter took over as interim head coach, and the results flipped. Since the break, Philadelphia has gone 12-1-4, including a 15-match unbeaten run, and climbed to sixth place.
It is the club's eighth playoff appearance in nine seasons and its 10th overall, a strong result for a team that looked out of contention at midseason.
## A shutout without the top scorers

The draw in Nashville came against the team that has already won the Supporters' Shield, and the Union managed it short-handed. Bruno Damiani was suspended for yellow-card accumulation, while Cavan Sullivan and [Milan Iloski](/players/milan-iloski/) were out injured. Iloski has 19 goals, tied for third in the league's scoring race.

[Andre Blake](/players/andre-blake/), wearing the captain's armband, anchored a back line that kept Nashville off the scoresheet in its own building. That is no small feat. Nashville had won 14 and drawn one of its first 15 home matches this season, according to Sixonefivesoccer.
## What's next

Philadelphia visits FC Cincinnati on Saturday, Oct. 31, at 2 p.m. ET, with two regular-season matches left to improve its seeding. Fans can see how Union players stack up against stars around the league on our [top selling MLS jerseys](/top-selling-mls-jerseys/) page.
Few teams recover from a start like Philadelphia's. Now the Union head into the postseason as one of the league's form sides, and a dangerous draw for anyone.
